TITLE: Three-Band Lattice
DESCRIPTION: Internal renderer-test archetype. A grid lattice whose row, column, and cell-core channels split the bass / mid / treble groupings of chroma_AudioFFT[8] (low [0..2] -> warm rows, mid [3..5] -> green columns, high [6..7] -> blue cores). RMS lifts ambient glow, peak expands the cores, syn_BPM sets the pulse cadence, and RENDERSIZE keeps the lattice square. Renders a sane static lattice at zero audio. Not shipped in the bundled library; reference/test fixture only.
